command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
echo "== tmpfs is the constraint here: samtools sort's temp files land in /tmp, which is RAM =="
df -m /tmp | awk 'NR==2{print "tmpfs_total_mb", $2; print "tmpfs_used_before_mb", $3}'
awk '/MemTotal/{printf "mem_total_gib %.0f\n", $2/1048576}' /proc/meminfo

# Sample tmpfs high-water while the sort runs. The whole point: on the task path `sort -T /tmp`
# spends RAM, not disk, and nothing warns you.
( MAX=0
  while :; do
    U=$(df -m /tmp | awk 'NR==2{print $3}')
    [ "$U" -gt "$MAX" ] && { MAX=$U; echo "$MAX" > /tmp/.peak; }
    sleep 2
  done ) & SAMPLER=$!

echo "== samtools sort, 48.8M records =="
T0=$(date +%s)
samtools sort -@ 16 -m 1G -T /tmp/sorttmp -o aln.sorted.bam aln.sam.gz 2> sort.log
T1=$(date +%s)
SORT_S=$(( T1 - T0 ))
kill "$SAMPLER" 2>/dev/null || true
PEAK_MB=$(cat /tmp/.peak 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

echo "== samtools index =="
T2=$(date +%s)
samtools index -@ 16 aln.sorted.bam
T3=$(date +%s)
IDX_S=$(( T3 - T2 ))

echo "== checks =="
# BGZF/gzip magic: a BAM starts 1f8b0804. Cheap, exact, cannot go flaky.
MAGIC=$(od -An -tx1 -N4 aln.sorted.bam | tr -d ' \n')
# quickcheck verifies the EOF block is present, which is what catches a truncated BAM.
QC=0; samtools quickcheck -v aln.sorted.bam 2>/dev/null && QC=1
SORTED=$(samtools view -H aln.sorted.bam | awk '/^@HD/ && /SO:coordinate/{print "yes"}')
NREC=$(samtools view -c -@ 16 aln.sorted.bam)
MAPPED_PCT=$(samtools flagstat -@ 16 aln.sorted.bam | awk '/mapped \(/{gsub(/[(%]/,"",$5); print $5; exit}')
samtools flagstat -@ 16 aln.sorted.bam > flagstat.txt
BAMB=$(stat -c%s aln.sorted.bam)
HASIDX=0; [ -s aln.sorted.bam.bai ] && HASIDX=1

{
  echo "sort_wall_s          $SORT_S"
  echo "index_wall_s         $IDX_S"
  echo "tmpfs_total_mb       $(df -m /tmp | awk 'NR==2{print $2}')"
  echo "tmpfs_peak_used_mb   $PEAK_MB  <- samtools sort temp + staged input + output, all in RAM"
  echo "bam_magic            $MAGIC  want 1f8b0804"
  echo "quickcheck           $QC  want 1 (EOF block present, so not truncated)"
  echo "sort_order           $SORTED  want yes"
  echo "records              $NREC  want exactly 48817006 (sorting is a permutation)"
  echo "pct_mapped           $MAPPED_PCT  want ~99.91, as bwa reported"
  echo "bam_index            $HASIDX  want 1"
  echo "bam_bytes            $BAMB"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$MAGIC" = '1f8b0804'
test "$QC" -eq 1
test "$SORTED" = 'yes'
test "$HASIDX" -eq 1
# Conservation: sort and index must not create or lose a single record. Exact, and free.
test "$NREC" = '48817006'
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
